prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game asset blockout sketch for Impressor
Primary request: Create a reference sketch of Небольшой грузовик с кабиной и закрытым грузовым кузовом..
Purpose: Выбрать крупные массы грузовика перед процедурной сборкой игрового ассета.
Iteration question: Различимы ли кабина, грузовой кузов и опора на колёса без окон и деталей?
Workflow pass: cube_massing
Scene/backdrop: Plain off-white background; no environment or props. A subtle ground contact shadow is allowed only in the angled view.
Style/medium: Clean grayscale industrial design sketch with straight construction edges and simple flat shaded planes. Low fidelity programmer art; crisp silhouette, no painterly decoration.
Composition/framing: One projection sheet of the SAME object, with seven views in a fixed two-row, four-column grid. First row, left to right: front, rear, left, right. Second row: top, bottom, isometric, empty cell. Exactly one object instance per occupied cell, entirely visible with clear margins; no alternatives or extra panels.
View contract: impressor/projections/v1. Use glTF/Godot axes: +Y up, +Z front, +X right. Front/rear cameras are on +Z/-Z, left/right on -X/+X, top/bottom on +Y/-Y, looking toward the object center. All six are strict orthographic projections, with no perspective convergence or visible adjacent faces. Keep +Y up in front/rear/side panels; in top/bottom panels, keep +Z toward the top of the sheet: +X appears left in top and right in bottom. The separate angled view is true orthographic isometric, from +X,+Y,+Z, roughly 35.264 degrees elevation and 45 degrees around the vertical axis. One shared envelope in meters is [X=1.25, Y=1.5, Z=3]; ground is Y=0, bottom-center origin is (0,0,0). Use the same orthographic pixels-per-meter scale for all six panels; do not independently stretch or normalize each view to its cell. Derive every view from one shared arrangement of the named masses: identical dimensions, gaps, part counts, symmetry, contact points and ground plane. Occlusion may hide a part; never invent or remove a part to improve an individual panel. Use light flat plane shading in the orthographic views, without cast shadows that obscure boundaries; a subtle contact shadow is allowed only in isometric. These generated views remain a visual hypothesis: geometric consistency and measurements must be verified against projections rendered from one real 3D blockout.
Lighting/mood: Soft neutral studio light; readable large planes, restrained contrast.
Functional masses and placement:
- Кабина — один прямоугольный блок спереди, ниже и короче грузового кузова.
- Закрытый грузовой кузов — один крупный прямоугольный блок позади кабины.
- Шасси — один тонкий горизонтальный прямоугольный блок под кабиной и кузовом.
- Четыре колеса — четыре кубических заменителя по бокам шасси, по два на ось; все проекции описывают одни и те же четыре блока.
Proportions: Длина примерно вдвое больше общей высоты; ширина немного меньше высоты.; Кабина занимает примерно треть длины, кузов около двух третей.; Между кабиной и кузовом небольшой читаемый зазор.
Geometry: ONLY cubes and rectangular cuboids with orthogonal faces. All masses are simple axis-aligned box placeholders. Preserve gaps needed to distinguish the masses.
Materials/textures: Uniform neutral matte grey; no textures or colored accents.
Constraints: Show only the requested object and its named functional masses.; Keep the same view layout, shared scale, light and background across iterations.; Separate large masses through shape and placement, not decorative details.; Use box placeholders for every curved part, including wheels; no curved geometry.; Preserve: Компоновка с передней кабиной, задним кузовом и двумя осями.
Text: No text, labels, dimensions, logos or watermark anywhere in the image.
Avoid: People, surroundings, extra objects and dramatic perspective.; Tiny decorative features and visually busy shading.; Curved shapes and decorative details.; Окна, бамперы, зеркала, ручки, решётки и круглые колёса на этом проходе.; cylinders, spheres, wedges, bevels, round wheels; windows, panel seams, bolts, lamps, decals, textures
Output intent: A readable visual hypothesis for later procedural modeling, not a CAD drawing or a finished 3D asset.
